title: 298. Best Time to Buy and Sell Stock III

examples.explanation: Buy at 0, sell at 3, then buy at 1 and sell at 4 for 3 + 3 = 6.
One trade from 1 to 5 already gives 4; a second trade adds nothing.
Prices only fall, so skipping all trades is best.

hints: Track four states in one pass: first buy, first sell, second buy, second sell.
Update them in order so the second buy can reuse profit from the first sell.
Splitting at each day into best-left plus best-right profit also works.
